text: The platform looks finished -- but looks finished and is correct are different claims. During validation, Store 11's numbers come in consistently low, even though the nightly job has reported success every single night.
A raw count check against staging shows the truth: roughly six percent of Store 11's transactions never made it into fact_sales, with no failure anywhere in the run log.

The root cause lived in the Transform package's product lookup. It was correctly set to redirect unmatched rows -- but the destination table it wrote to had a schema mismatch, so every write to that error table silently failed too, and the package kept reporting success anyway.
Two fixes: correct the table schema, and set FailParentOnError to true on that destination -- because an error path that can itself fail silently defeats the entire point of having one.

After re-running the affected night, we add a permanent accounting check: every staged row must land in exactly one of loaded, product-unmatched, or store-unmatched. If those counts ever stop adding up, that's the alert now.
A real bug, caught before it ever reached a report anyone trusted. Next: proving the dashboard reconciles against the source, formally and repeatably.
